select b.id, b.cfg_id, b.oa_dept_id, b.wx_dept_key as wx_dept_id, b.wx_parent_dept_key as wx_parent_dept_id, b.yx as bind_state, b.remark, b.modedatacreatedate, b.modedatacreatetime, b.modedatamodifydatetime, d.departmentname as oa_dept_name, d.supdepid as oa_dept_parent, d.subcompanyid1 as oa_subcompany_id, s.subcompanyname as oa_subcompany_name, d.canceled as oa_canceled, t.status as wx_tmp_status, c.corp_name as cfg_name, c.corp_id as cfg_corp_id from ${deptBindTable} b left join hrmdepartment d on d.id = b.oa_dept_id left join hrmsubcompany s on s.id = d.subcompanyid1 left join ${cfgTable} c on c.id = b.cfg_id left join ${deptTmpTable} t on t.corpid = c.corp_id and t.wx_dept_key = b.wx_dept_key
and b.cfg_id = #{cfgId}
and (d.departmentname like #{keyword} or c.corp_name like #{keyword} or b.wx_dept_key like #{keyword})
order by b.cfg_id, b.oa_dept_id, b.id

select id, cfg_id, oa_dept_id, wx_dept_key as wx_dept_id, wx_parent_dept_key as wx_parent_dept_id, yx, remark, modedatacreater, modedatacreatedate, modedatacreatetime, modedatamodifier, modedatamodifydatetime from ${table} where id = #{id}
select min(id) from ${table} where cfg_id = #{cfgId} and oa_dept_id = #{oaDeptId} and yx = 1
select id from ${table} where cfg_id = #{cfgId} and wx_dept_key = #{wxDeptId} and yx = 1
